Only the material checkpoints regarding the appearance of the bread itself are 'Present'. The Router did not miss any checkpoints; it correctly identified that the subject matter (bread) exists but the class context (shop) is entirely absent.

However, visual inspection reveals the plate pattern warping into the background, which SAM might ignore if the color contrast is low. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no graphics-level distortions. I agree with the Router that the plate-edge blending is an artifact (severity ~2.5-3.0), as the geometry of the plate rim dissolves unnaturally. The flour texture does look slightly 'painted' or smudged (severity ~2.0).

These are moderate artifacts that degrade the image quality below photorealistic standards, but do not constitute catastrophic failure. The high SAM confidence suggests the core shape is intact, but the boundary details are flawed.
